title: Krishna - Makhan Chor
overview: Krishna - Makhan Chor shows the infant Krishna growing up in Gokul under the love and care of his foster parents, Nand-Lal and Yashoda, to become the popular, mischievous but lovable 'KANHA' of Gokul.

songs.title: Kanha Biraj mei Padharey
songs.singers: Krishna The Great, Pranali, Priyanka, Sohail Kaul
